product.name: Discord OAuth2 for apps and bots (Developer Portal)

oauthAppCreation.where: The Discord Developer Portal: create an application, then use its client ID and OAuth2 settings

reviewGate.trigger: An app can be built and used without review; verification is required once an app is in 100 or more guilds, and privileged intents are approved after that verification.

source.quote: For verified apps (required for apps in 100+ guilds)

approvalWait.stated: The developer documentation states no verification turnaround.

testBeforeApproval.how: An unverified app works in fewer than 100 guilds, so it can be built and tested before verification

source.quote: For verified apps (required for apps in 100+ guilds)
allows /users/@me/guilds to return basic information about all of a user’s guilds
allows /guilds/{guild.id}/members/{user.id} to be used for joining users to a guild
allows /users/@me/connections to return linked third-party accounts
allows your app to add commands to a guild - included by default with the bot scope

blockers.summary: Apps in 100 or more guilds must be verified

source.quote: For verified apps (required for apps in 100+ guilds)

blockers.summary: Privileged intents can be requested only after the app is verified, in the Developer Portal

source.quote: After your app is verified, you can request privileged intents within the app’s settings within the Developer Portal.

blockers.summary: Adding a user to a guild with guilds.join needs the bot to already be in that guild

source.quote: In order to add a user to a guild, your bot has to already belong to that guild.

avoidProducts.name: Discord end-user help center
avoidProducts.why: End-user help articles, not the developer API
avoidProducts.evidence: The developer documentation lives on docs.discord.com and discord.com/developers; support.discord.com is for users.

notes: Researched after the holdout was spent and after the last code change; no stage was tuned on this app.
Discord's rules moved from a 100-server trigger to a user-count threshold for privileged intents; the gateway page still states 100+ guilds for verification.
